errors.evidence: The x-axis in the figure has no label. The description hallucinates the label 'λ', likely inferred from the paper's caption.
The y-axis is not labeled. 'F1值' is the title of the chart, not the y-axis label.
The y-axis range shown is from 75 to 83, not 75.2 to 83.1.
The y-axis has a tick interval of 1 (75, 76, 77...), not 5.
The chart does not specify that the unit for the F1 value is percentage.
The line starts at x=0 with a value of 77.52. The value at x=1.0 is 77.65. The description confuses the start and end points.

errors.text_span: 以大约80.57的数值在0.6处达到峰值
errors.evidence: The peak value is 82.13, and it occurs at x=0.6. The value 80.57 occurs at x=0.8, which is not the peak.
The value at x=0.9 is 79.03, which is not the minimum value. The minimum value on the chart is 77.52 at x=0.
The value at the end of the x-axis (x=1.0) is 77.65. The value 82.13 is the peak value, which occurs at x=0.6.
